+from fastapi import FastAPI
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from pydantic import BaseModel
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+class Item(BaseModel):
+    name: str
+    price: float
+
+@app.post("/items")
+def create_item(item: Item):
+    return item
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+def test_openapi_validation_error_schema():
+    response = client.get("/openapi.json")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    data = response.json()
+    assert "components" in data, "components missing from openapi.json"
+    assert "schemas" in data["components"], "schemas missing from components"
+    assert "ValidationError" in data["components"]["schemas"], "ValidationError missing from schemas"
+    validation_error = data["components"]["schemas"]["ValidationError"]
+    print(f"ValidationError schema: {validation_error}")
+    assert "input" in validation_error["properties"], "input missing from ValidationError properties"
+    assert "ctx" in validation_error["properties"], "ctx missing from ValidationError properties"
+    assert validation_error["properties"]["ctx"]["type"] == "object", "ctx type should be object"
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        test_openapi_validation_error_schema()
+        print("Test passed!")
+    except AssertionError as e:
+        print(f"Test failed: {e}")
+        exit(1)
+    except Exception as e:
+        import traceback
+        traceback.print_exc()
+        exit(1)
